label: Nothing is moved except insofar as it is in POTENCY_1 to that toward…, from countertuple refutation
meaning: Whatever is moved in a respect is in potency in that respect, from the conclusion of NO-MOVED-NOT-POTENT-COUNTERTUPLE-FROM-ABILITY-AND-INCOMPLETENESS (the exact moved-not-potent countertuple fails on the same MovedIn and InPotency) and excluded middle. Its premises (what is being moved to r is able to be r and not yet r; potency as unactualized capacity) stay OPEN; the route premise is not established.
